title: Chunk Pulse: per-chunk provenance, sampled metrics, and adaptive redaction for streaming outputs
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Problem: Streaming responses (incremental token/chunk delivery) are currently opaque to downstream observability: we lack stable per-chunk provenance identifiers, lightweight per-chunk metrics, and a safe redaction flow that operates incrementally while preserving trace linkage. This gap blocks: (1) root-cause analysis for partial responses, (2) latency vs. cost attribution for streaming workloads, and (3) audited redaction for streamed PII that may appear mid-stream.

Goal: Deliver a reproducible playbook and implementation plan that provides: 1) a compact per-chunk provenance token (Chunk Pulse ID) propagated across traces/logs; 2) a small, fixed metrics set emitted per chunk with sampling rules; 3) span naming and baggage conventions for streamed tool/function calls; 4) an adaptive redaction layer that performs streaming-aware redaction and exposes redaction metadata without leaking sensitive content.

Out of scope: full content re-synthesis or model-side PII suppression (we assume redaction runs in the serving layer), and UI dashboard work beyond example queries.

Success criteria: see acceptance_criteria below.
acceptance_criteria: Chunk Pulse ID is generated for every streaming session and every chunk; ID is stable for the chunk and appears as a tag on metrics, logs, and spans.
Per-chunk metrics are emitted with <=1ms instrumentation overhead at 1M rps scale in a canary environment: metrics: chunk_emit_delay_ms (p95), chunk_token_count, chunk_size_bytes, chunk_error_flag.
Tracing: each chunk emits a short-lived span with standardized name patterns and links to the parent request trace and tool-call spans when applicable.
Adaptive redaction: a streaming sanitizer runs on chunk boundaries, redacts ephemeral PII tokens, and emits redaction_events (type, reason, safe_hash) without logging original values.
Sampling rules documented and implementable: head sampling for early chunks, tail sampling for final chunk, and priority sampling for tool-invocation chunks.
Playbook includes rollforward/rollback runbook, OpenTelemetry mapping, and Kibana/Grafana example queries for debugging.
Automated tests: unit tests for ID generation, property-based tests for redaction rules, and integration tests exercising trace linking across chunk+tool call sequences.
implementation_notes: Chunk Pulse ID: 128-bit base62 compact token composed of (session_prefix):(seq_no):(shard_hash) with a CRC4 trailer for quick collision detection.
Attach Chunk Pulse ID as: metric_tag 'chunk_pulse', span attribute 'chunk.pulse_id', and log field 'chunk_pulse_id'.
Metrics emission: counters/gauges histogram instruments using existing telemetry pipeline; low-cardinality tags only: model, region, route, chunk_type (prefix/mid/final), chunk_pulse.
Span naming: 'stream.chunk.emit' for emission spans, 'stream.toolcall.{tool_name}' for tool calls triggered within a chunk. Use semantic convention 'chunk.index' and 'chunk.sequence_start_ts'.

Redaction: implement composed sanitizer chain: token_classifier -> regex heuristics -> entropy heuristics -> deterministic hash fallback. Always replace with stable safe_hash and include redaction_reason tag. No original PII should be emitted beyond debug builds behind feature flag.

Sampling policy: default sample_rate=0.01. Override to 1.0 for chunks with tool calls, errors, or when flagged by QA test harness. Support dynamic sample_rate adjustment from console via config. Document formula: effective_sample = max(global_rate, error_rate_override, toolcall_override, tail_fraction_for_final_chunk).
Compatibility: provide compatibility shim for older SDKs that only support a single request-level trace by encoding chunk metadata in a compact header 'X-Chunk-Meta' with base62 encoding.
redaction_policy_summary: Streaming sanitizer MUST operate deterministically on chunk boundaries. Priority order: model output classifiers (low false positive target) -> domain regex (credit-card, ssn patterns) -> entropy-based heuristics for long numeric sequences -> deterministic hashing. Emit redaction_event with fields: type, reason, safe_hash. Debug mode may also emit redaction_examples to secure storage (access controlled).
tracing_schema: Use OpenTelemetry semantic attributes. Span name prefix 'stream.chunk.'; attributes: chunk.pulse_id, chunk.index (int), chunk.type (prefix|mid|final), request.id, model.name, region, tool.call_id (if applicable). Link to parent request span using trace_id/parent_id. Short span duration (<20ms) and low cardinality attributes only.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: high cardinatlity if chunk_pulse is used broadly in LT dashboards. Mitigation: only propagate chunk_pulse into high-cardinality stores when sampled; otherwise use aggregated buckets and sampled traces.
Risk: redaction false positives impact quality. Mitigation: conservative classifier thresholds in production, ability to QA holdback and label false positives for retraining.
Risk: additional CPU for streaming sanitizer at high throughput. Mitigation: implement fast-path regex and compiled automata; provide per-route feature flag to disable for low-risk routes.
tasks: Design and doc: finalize Chunk Pulse token format and write spec (owner: Ravi).
Infra: add lightweight metric hooks in serving runtime and ensure <1ms overhead (owner: Priya Kaur).
Tracing: implement span thin wrapper and OTEL mapping (owner: Marco Li).
Sanitizer: implement streaming sanitizer chain with safe_hash output and tests (owner: Linh Tran).
SDK shim: add backward-compatible X-Chunk-Meta header for older SDKs (owner: Jose Alvarez).
Canary: deploy to region-west canary at 1% traffic, validate metrics and trace linking (owner: SRE team).
comments: 2025-02-14 - Ava Martinez: Initial technical draft posted. Requesting feedback on token format and metric names.
2025-02-18 - Marco Li: Proposed using OTEL 'link' to parent instead of span parenting for mid-stream toolcall spans — reduces trace foresting. Marked as preferred in notes.
2025-02-21 - Linh Tran: Pushed MVP sanitizer prototype branch; initial tests show 0.8ms median overhead on sample workload. Raising perf improvement ticket if >1ms observed at scale.
2025-02-25 - Priya Kaur: Confirmed metrics pipeline has capacity; recommend using histogram buckets aligned with existing latency buckets.
2025-02-28 - Ravi Desai: Merged ID-format doc and opened runtime PR #5421. Preparing canary deploy next week.
2025-03-01 - QA: Added integration test cases for toolcall chunks and redaction event presence. All passing in CI except one flaky case for long numeric sequences.
notes_for_release: Gate rollout with feature flag 'chunk_pulse' and 'stream_sanitizer'. Start at 1% canary -> 10% -> 100% over 2 weeks. Monitor chunk_error_flag_count and chunk_emit_delay p95 closely. If p95 > 15ms or sanitizer CPU > 10% of serving tier, rollback the sanitizer feature flag and open follow-up perf tickets.
